## Recap(III)

### Local Variables

Variables defined inside a function are local to it, they are not accessible outside the function.

```c
1#include <stdio.h>
2
3void addNumbers(int n1, int n2) {
4
5  int result = n1 + n2;
6}
7
8int main() {
9
10  // Error: 'result' is undeclared
11  printf("%d", result);
12
13  return 0;
14}
```

### Standard Library Functions

C provides various built-in functions that we can directly use in our program by including the required header file.

```c
1#include <stdio.h> // for I/O operations
2#include <math.h> // for math operations
3
4int main() {
5
6  double squareRoot = sqrt(81);
7  printf("%.2lf", squareRoot);    // 9.00
8
9  return 0;
10}
```
